scope: Swedish TED CPV 7231 notices in September 2026 compared with Licitera's free September procurement export
attribution: Licitera (licitera.se), CC BY 4.0; Uppgifter: Upphandlingsmyndigheten | Bearbetning: Licitera | Analys: AgentMine. TED official public Search API.

provenance.validation: Downloaded GitHub Actions aggregate-only ZIP; SHA-256 matched GitHub artifact digest and job log. Parsed aggregate JSON; CI job log reports 541 tests OK.

interpretation: Two of the three TED contract notices absent by exact publication number from Licitera's September export share an official procedure UUID with an already exact-matched TED notice. They therefore cannot be counted as three independently established new procurement procedures. The remaining one lacks a same-procedure match only WITHIN this bounded September 7231 matched cohort; it may be linked to a different month, classification or procurement entity. Zero in-cohort explicit prior-notice links is not proof that no links exist elsewhere.
next_gate: Inspect the one unmatched distinct-UUID notice against lawful official cross-month procedure references and test actual incumbent product search via authorized access. Validate supplier task outcomes and willingness to pay before prioritizing marketplace monetization.
